paper.title_en: Regular spherically symmetric solutions in General Relativity and scalar-tensor gravity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics and their stability
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the geometric, dynamical, and thermodynamic properties of a novel class of regular black holes in scalar-tensor gravity non-minimally coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics (NED). By incorporating a purely magnetic NED source within a scalar-tensor framework, we circumvent the classical ``no-go'' theorems. These theorems, strictly formulated for scalar-free Einstein-NED systems, prohibit regular configurations for purely electric fields due to the fundamental requirement of recovering the linear Maxwell limit at spatial infinity. The geometric analysis demonstrates the complete resolution of the central Penrose singularity, replacing it with a regular, globally bounded vacuum core ($|ρ_c| < \infty$). While purely electromagnetic regular black holes canonically possess a de Sitter center, the deep potential well of the scalar field in our model structurally alters this standard geometry, yielding a locally Anti-de Sitter (AdS-like) regime characterized by a strictly negative central energy density ($ρ_c < 0$). To assess the physical viability of these configurations, we analyze their dynamical stability against odd-parity (axial) linear gravitational perturbations. The derived Regge-Wheeler-like effective potential is strictly positive and convex outside the event horizon. Numerical time-domain integration, independently corroborated by the semi-analytical WKB approximation, confirms the total absence of exponentially growing modes, revealing a stable quasi-normal ringing phase followed by an exponential decay. Furthermore, our thermodynamic analysis of the mass-radius relation directly indicates that the semi-classical Hawking evaporation must terminate at the extremal limit ($M = M_{min}$), leaving behind a massive thermodynamic remnant, thereby providing a theoretical framework toward resolving the black hole information loss paradox.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提出了一类新的标量-张量引力与非最小耦合非线性电动力学下的规则黑洞，通过构造避免了奇点，并分析了其动力学稳定性和热力学性质，具有较高的理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 广义相对论和标量-张量引力中与非线性电动力学耦合的规则球对称解及其稳定性
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一类新型规则黑洞在标量-张量引力中非最小耦合到非线性电动力学（NED）的几何、动力学和热力学性质。通过将纯磁NED源纳入标量-张量框架，我们绕过了经典的“no-go”定理。这些定理严格适用于无标量的爱因斯坦-NED系统，由于在空间无穷远处恢复线性麦克斯韦极限的基本要求，纯电场无法实现规则构型。几何分析表明，中心彭罗斯奇点被完全解决，取而代之的是一个规则的、全局有界的真空核心（|ρ_c| < ∞）。虽然纯电磁规则黑洞典型地具有德西特中心，但我们的模型中标量场的深势阱在结构上改变了这种标准几何，产生了一个局部反德西特（AdS-like）区域，其特征是严格负的中心能量密度（ρ_c < 0）。为了评估这些构型的物理可行性，我们分析了它们对奇宇称（轴向）线性引力扰动的动力学稳定性。导出的Regge-Wheeler类有效势在事件视界外严格为正且凸。数值时域积分，经半解析WKB近似独立验证，确认完全不存在指数增长模式，显示稳定的准正规振铃阶段随后是指数衰减。此外，我们对质量-半径关系的热力学分析直接表明，半经典霍金蒸发必须在极端极限（M = M_min）处终止，留下一个质量热力学残余，从而为解决黑洞信息丢失悖论提供了一个理论框架。
